# Nidhal Selmi

> A personal site featuring clear, interactive visual demos designed to help readers internalize data-science fundamentals and build deeper intuition through direct exploration.

## Interactive demos

- [Classification Trade-offs Mini-Lab](https://nselmi.com/binary-classification.html): A simplified 2D binary-classification demo for exploring class geometry, prevalence, decision thresholds, confusion-matrix metrics, ROC and precision-recall curves, and common evaluation trade-offs.
- [Impossible Fractal Cellular Automaton](https://nselmi.com/impossible-fractal-ca.html): An interactive explorer for a four-state cellular automaton on triangular tessellations.
- [Reaction-Diffusion Oscillator Lab](https://nselmi.com/reaction-diffusion-lab.html): A WebGL2 lab for a kernel-convolution cellular automaton driven by a global oscillator, with six kernel families, ten activation functions, calibrated palettes, two-parameter sweeps, and a live linear-stability (dispersion relation) analysis that unifies Turing patterns, SmoothLife and Lenia as one discrete-time neural field.

## Site

- [Home](https://nselmi.com/): Nidhal Selmi's personal site and index of interactive demos.
